title: Claude Marketplace: one place to discover plugins, agents, and services from our partners
summary: Launch of Claude Marketplace, a unified hub consolidating 2,000+ plugins, Claude-powered agents and products, and consulting services. Customers can apply existing Anthropic commitments to marketplace offerings, streamlining procurement and giving partners direct access to Claude's customer base.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: Case study showing how CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot use Claude Marketplace to integrate Snowflake and Vercel services. Customers redirect existing Anthropic commitments to partner services, streamlining procurement and consolidating vendor approvals into a single process.

title: How to prepare for AI-driven code modernization projects
summary: Guide for enterprises and regulated organizations preparing for large-scale codebase modernization using Claude Code. The six-step framework emphasizes traceability and governance, with every change linked to an agent transcript and certificate evidence. Pre-staging organizational approval processes balances speed of agentic code generation with human oversight in regulated environments.

title: What a task costs on Opus 5.5
summary: Opus 5.5 costs 20% less per input and output token than prior versions, with cache read pricing dropping 60%. Typical sessions save approximately 31% on cost from pricing changes alone. Key cost drivers include turn count, cache hit rate, output tokens, and model selection; smaller models like Sonnet and Haiku work well for lookups.

title: Working at the frontier: How Balyasny Asset Management evaluates and governs Claude Fable 5
summary: Interview with Balyasny Asset Management's Chief AI Officer on deploying Claude Fable 5 across 1,000s of autonomous agents for financial analysis. Claude Fable 5 achieved 89.4% accuracy on proprietary evals, with governance controls including data boundaries, tool permissions, and human review of material decisions.

title: Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation
summary: Claude Projects was redesigned from a folder-based system to a conversation-driven workflow where a coordinator manages multiple parallel worker threads and automatically handles merge conflicts. Users set project goals and maintain shared memory of context across sessions, enabling long-running, multi-session builds with remote steering and no manual handoffs.
